name: developer-roadmap-plugin
title: Complete Developer Roadmap Plugin - 66 Roles & Career Paths
description: Comprehensive learning system based on kamranahmedse/developer-roadmap with 66 different development roles, 7 specialized agents, and advanced skill tracking. Covers all career paths: Frontend, Backend, DevOps, Data/AI, Mobile, Game Dev, Security, Architecture, and more.

agents.name: Web Development Specialist
agents.description: Expert in all web development roles: Frontend, Backend, Full Stack, and framework-specific paths (React, Vue, Angular, Next.js, Node.js, Laravel, ASP.NET Core, etc.)

agents.name: Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer
agents.description: Specialist in DevOps, containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), cloud platforms (AWS), and Linux systems

agents.name: Data & AI Specialist
agents.description: Expert in Machine Learning, AI Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Analysis, BI, MLOps, and AI-based development patterns

agents.name: Architecture & System Design Expert
agents.description: Specialist in software architecture, system design, design patterns, API design, scalability, and enterprise architecture principles

agents.name: Mobile & Game Developer
agents.description: Expert in mobile development (Android, iOS, React Native, Flutter) and game development (Client-side, Server-side game architecture)

agents.name: Security & Quality Specialist
agents.description: Expert in cybersecurity, QA/Testing, code review practices, security best practices, and compliance frameworks

agents.name: Professional Development Advisor
agents.description: Specialist in career development roles: Product Management, Engineering Management, Technical Writing, DevRel, and UX Design

commands.name: Start Learning Path
commands.description: Discover and start a learning path for any of the 66 development roles

commands.name: Browse All Roles
commands.description: Explore all 66 available development roles and career paths

commands.name: Knowledge Assessment
commands.description: Assess your current knowledge level for any role or skill

commands.name: Browse Projects
